newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras to create physical agro exchange in '97.
newsitem.headline: Honduras to create physical agro exchange in '97.

text.p: Honduras will create an agricultural products and services exchange, to be known as the AGROBOLSA, to buy and sell physical farming commodities in early 1997, a businessman said Tuesday.

"The AGROBOLSA will permit a more transparent trade in agricultural products and offer prices that are remunerative to producers and fair to consumers," said Pedro Sevilla, an agricultural businessman.

The new exchange will offer beans, corn, sorghum and rice and will later include products such as coffee, meats and lumber. The exchange will not open until a law regulating its operation is approved.
Under Honduras' current system, so-called "coyotes" buy farm produce at low prices and sell it to consumers at high prices.
